resources.string: Readable phone media only. Rings show verified copies, not uploads still awaiting confirmation.
Advanced: use your own API credentials
This build has no configured application credentials. Ask the app owner for a configured build, or use advanced setup below. Each user still signs into their own Telegram account.
Recovery was interrupted. Already indexed items are kept. Retry to scan safely again; an incomplete scan is not a successful restore.
Photo index restored, but album/archive metadata could not be restored. Retry recovery; do not delete your Telegram key note or metadata files.
New phone or reinstall? Sign in to the same Telegram account, then restore an existing backup before creating a new storage. Originals are downloaded separately from Cloud.
Search names, folders, dates and media types. This build has no AI or image analysis; cloud search is metadata-only.
Protect Memora when opened and after 30 seconds in the background. Uses your phone PIN, pattern or password. Background backup can continue.
Verify your Telegram account and destination to see backup coverage. A hidden cloud index does not mean your backups were deleted.
API ID must be the number from my.telegram.org
The code is sent by Telegram to this phone number’s account, not to us.
Your account has two-step verification enabled. Enter that password; it never leaves the device.
Deleted photos and videos wait here for 30 days, then they are removed for good.
Permanently delete everything in the bin? This cannot be undone.

Normally Android asks Allow or Deny every time an app deletes a photo. To remove that question Memora needs "All files access". After that a delete quietly moves the file into Memora\'s bin, where you can restore it for 30 days. Memora uses the permission only when you delete something.
An unfinished upload was removed and queued again
